prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon runner preparing for race day - maximize carbohydrate loading and hydration

solution_criteria: Meal plan totals 4000+ calories with carbohydrates comprising 60-65% of total energy
Includes 3 meals and 2-3 snacks with specific hydration strategy (total fluid intake specified)
Compact format with meal timing, portions, and key macronutrient breakdown for each item
task_description: write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring 4000+ calories with emphasis on carbohydrate loading and hydration strategy

prompt_inputs.goal: strength and power development for weightlifting competition

solution_criteria: Meal plan spans exactly 1 day with clear meal timing
Includes high protein content (minimum 2.0g per kg bodyweight) distributed across meals
Contains pre-training and post-training meal recommendations with appropriate macronutrient composition
Plan is concise and practical (no more than 5-6 meals listed with brief descriptions)
task_description: write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) needing protein-focused meals with strategic timing around training sessions

prompt_inputs.goal: Maintain weight at 71kg for lightweight boxing division while maximizing strength and endurance for 12-round fights
prompt_inputs.restrictions: No dairy due to lactose intolerance

solution_criteria: Meal plan totals approximately 2,400-2,600 calories to maintain current weight without excess
Includes 4-5 meals distributed throughout the day with adequate protein (1.6-2.0g per kg body weight) for muscle recovery
Contains no dairy products and accommodates lactose intolerance
Provides balanced macronutrients supporting both strength training and cardiovascular endurance for boxing performance
task_description: write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a sport with specific weight class constraints (boxer or wrestler) requiring calorie control while maintaining performance nutrition
